Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended, including the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007; and Beneficial Ownership Information Regulations applicable to international companies issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the beneficial owner’s country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Current proof of residential address (utility bill or bank account statement, dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed commercial bank in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming identity and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank holding the client’s operating account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML/CFT due diligence questionnaire and source of wealth declaration executed by each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner and licensed Samoan registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate certificate of incumbency, certificate of good standing, beneficial ownership register and board resolution (if a corporate beneficial owner is used)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the corporate shareholder’s country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized engagement letter and power of attorney appointing the Samoan registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate beneficial owner or corporate director by notarial deed

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory name screening for each ultimate beneficial owner, director and authorised signatory against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, EU CFSP consolidated financial sanctions list, UK OFSI list, Australian DFAT Consolidated List and Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit domestic designations. All positive PEP matches trigger enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth review and approval by the registered agent’s Money Laundering Reporting Officer; beneficial ownership information is filed with the licensed agent and made available to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful request.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry Online Portal maintained by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), filings submitted by a licensed Samoan registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be in Latin script reflecting English or Samoan characters. Any non-Latin script, including Chinese, may be used for the company’s internal operating name only if a Romanised transliteration is stated in the Memorandum and Articles; no statutory name clearance is available for non-Latin characters alone.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Before expiry, the registered agent may file a written extension request with the Registrar of International Companies; one 30-day extension is ordinarily available. On refusal, the registered agent must submit a written appeal stating grounds, together with any consent letter, within 14 days of the refusal notification. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 21 days. A final review may be sought before the Supreme Court of Samoa if the administrative remedy is exhausted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a substitute for the statutory registered office. Every International Company must maintain a registered office in Samoa at the physical address of its licensed registered agent. Virtual-office services are acceptable only for correspondence handling within the licensed agent’s office, not as a separate registered office address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 5% annual likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection for a non-regulated wholesale distribution international company; the licensed agent’s registered office is subject to periodic Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and Registrar compliance inspections.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 1998–2010; key provisions: s.5 (incorporation), s.8 (memorandum), s.12 (certificate of incorporation), s.25 (registered office), s.27 (capacity), s.52 (shares), s.87 (directors), s.97 (secretary), s.147 (registered agent), s.170 (tax exemption).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for incorporation (prescribed Form IN-1) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association lodged under s.5 of the International Companies Act 1987
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required. Authorized capital may be denominated in USD or any currency; paid-up capital may be nil at incorporation. No escrow account or capital deposit rule applies under Samoan law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE DIRECTOR OF [INSERT COMPANY NAME] (the 'Company'): RESOLVED THAT: (1) The Company adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association dated [Date] as filed with the Registrar of International and Foreign Companies; (2) The subscriber allotment of [•] ordinary shares at par value USD 0.01 per share to the initial shareholder is approved and the register of members is authorized to be entered; (3) The registered office of the Company at [address], care of the registered agent, is adopted as the statutory address; (4) [Name] is appointed as the Company's first director and [Name] as secretary; and (5) The director and secretary are authorized to execute all ancillary filings. This Resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia — submitted through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed company name (ending in Limited, Corp, Inc or PLC) for search against the Register of International Companies; verify no identical or deceptively similar name exists and confirm that restricted words (e.g., Bank, Trust, Insurance) are not used unless a waiver is obtained; pay the name search and reservation fee.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of proposed shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on similarity grounds, file two alternate names with an explanatory letter; if a restricted word is included, withdraw the word or apply for Ministerial consent before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent appointed under s.147 of the International Companies Act 1987
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the prescribed statutory form; have the subscriber execute the document; arrange notarization of signatures where the agent's KYC policy so requires; preserve original execution pages for submission to the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (original execution)
Certified passport copy of shareholder and director
Proof of residential address (utility bill not older than 3 months)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent queries the documentation, complete the KYC pack within 5 business days; re-execute any defective signature pages; obtain notarial certification or apostille for overseas execution if required by MCIL.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, MCIL, Apia (paper filing or e-filing through the approved agent portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the completed incorporation package with the Registry, pay the statutory government fee, and file the registered agent's consent; the application must declare the Samoan registered office address and confirm that the Company will conduct international business only.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (2 copies)
Consent to act of registered agent
Consent to act of first director and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If queried, respond to the Registrar's requisition within 14 days; correct any minor defect (e.g., signature page error) by filing a supplemental page; if the application is rejected, submit a fresh application with amended particulars and payment of the revised fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation Issuance and Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the Company comes into existence from the certificate date; verify the company number, exact name spelling, incorporation date, and stated share capital against the application; request a certified extract of the filed Memorandum and Articles.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the filed Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Within 7 days of issue, request the Registry to correct any clerical error in the certificate; if the certificate is lost or destroyed, file an application for a certified duplicate with the statutory fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First board of directors acting with the registered agent and company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a written resolution to adopt pre-incorporation contracts, allot initial shares to the subscriber, adopt the registered office address, appoint officers, authorize opening of the corporate bank account, and approve issuance of share certificates; record the resolutions in the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Register of members, directors, and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a purported appointment is invalid, hold a ratifying board meeting within 21 days; failure to formally adopt the registered office is cured by filing a notice of change of registered office with the Registrar under s.25 of the Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — offshore wholesale trading only; general non-industrial supervision by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None — International Companies are exempt from the Business Licences Act 1998 when conducting no onshore business; no ophthalmic wholesale-specific operating license is imposed under Samoan law

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Division of Environment and Conservation, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no manufacturing, effluent discharge, emissions, or land disturbance within Samoa; the activity is limited to administrative and re-export wholesale functions
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not triggered; no wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste streams are generated in Samoa. Any import of sample goods subject to the Waste Management Act 2016 transboundary movement rules if such samples are not re-exported or are disposed of locally.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for an offshore administrative existence. If a physical showroom or warehouse is later leased in Samoa, obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) and an occupational workplace clearance from the MCIL Labour Division prior to occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue, Government of Samoa – Inland Revenue and Customs Divisions; official taxpayer portal and customs information at https://www.revenue.gov.ws and https://www.customs.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoan International Company is prima facie exempt from local income tax and therefore is not required to hold a domestic TIN unless it carries on taxable activity within Samoa. If the entity makes taxable supplies, records export claims, or seeks input VAT recovery, it must submit the prescribed Business/Taxpayer Registration application to the Ministry for Revenue under the Tax Administration Act 2015, accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, and proof of non-resident ownership from the Registrar of International Companies under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election exists in Samoa. The International Company's offshore tax exemption is automatic. For indirect tax purposes, the entity may elect to register for VAGST on a voluntary basis to zero-rate exports and recover input tax; this election does not alter the entity-level tax-exempt classification under the International Companies Act.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (Samoan Tala) of annual taxable supplies; voluntary VAGST registration is permitted below this threshold for exporters
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic invoicing, no fiscal clearance API, and no digital stamping requirement. A registered business may issue VAT invoices electronically as long as content satisfies the VAGST invoice requirements. Tax records must be retained for five years; the Ministry for Revenue continues to roll out online return filing, but there is no real-time tax-authority invoice clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to a VAGST-registered supplier where tangible goods such as optical frames are physically exported from Samoa within the prescribed export disposition period, title passes to a non-resident purchaser, and the goods are consigned outside Samoa supported by Customs export entries. Offshore services qualify where the recipient belongs outside Samoa, the services are performed for the benefit of that foreign recipient, and no local value is enjoyed in Samoa. All zero-rated claims must be supported by contemporaneous commercial and banking records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate from a licensed Samoan bank
Certificate of Origin where requested by the buyer or correspondent bank
VAGST export claim schedule reconciling each zero-rated invoice to foreign exchange receipts
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Samoa conducts risk-based audits of export zero-rating, including source-of-funds review. If export documentation or forex repatriation evidence is deficient, the claimed zero rate is reversed and VAGST is assessed at 15% on the full invoice value, with late payment penalties and statutory interest. Intentional evasion or false substantiation triggers shortfall penalties up to 150%, criminal fines, and imprisonment under the Tax Administration Act 2015, and may additionally jeopardize the International Company's regulatory licence and exempt-status renewal.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is convertible for bona fide current account transactions on a documentary basis through authorised dealer banks. Capital account transactions require prior approval from the Central Bank of Samoa on a case-by-case basis. Profit and dividend remittances are permitted after audited financial statements are submitted and applicable dividend withholding tax has been deducted, but no blanket conversion right exists for non-resident shareholders. International Companies operating under the Samoan International Company regime must channel all foreign exchange through a licensed commercial bank and cannot access offshore EMI platforms due to the strict exchange control framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act 1970 and applicable Central Bank of Samoa directives, exporters must repatriate all export proceeds to Samoa within 90 days from the date of shipment. 100% of foreign currency export receipts must be offered for conversion into WST to an authorised dealer within 30 days of receipt, unless the Central Bank grants a specific exemption for retentions or working capital. Supporting documentation including commercial invoices, bills of lading/airway bills, packing lists, and customs declarations must be retained and produced to the authorised dealer for verification.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific Limited – Samoa Branch

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account with Correspondent Banking Access

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa does not maintain a fintech or Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing regime. Offshore digital EMIs, virtual account providers, and non-bank payment companies are not recognised by the Central Bank of Samoa and cannot operate as authorised dealers. Remittances routed through such entities are treated as high-risk and are generally rejected by Samoan commercial banks, creating a mandatory reliance on SWIFT through licensed correspondent banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of at least one director or a duly authorised signatory is required for initial account opening. Most Samoan commercial banks require the chartered signatory or beneficial owner to attend an in-branch identity interview. Remote opening via video KYC is available only for low-risk, fully screened non-resident clients, subject to notarised corporate documents, banker's reference letters, and proof of registered agent relationship; in practice, Samoan banks retain discretion and often mandate physical presence before activating internet banking or releasing local cards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner holding 100% equity in a Samoan International Company with no substantive local physical office or staff
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation, certificate of incumbency, full beneficial ownership declaration up to natural persons, audited financial statements, board resolution confirming the genuine wholesale optical frames business, tax residence certificate, commercial contracts with existing buyers, and letters from reputable upstream suppliers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity SWIFT outbound payments to East Asian optical frame manufacturers inconsistent with the entity's expected operational scale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed purchase orders, supplier contracts, itemised commercial invoices under HS code 9003, Bills of Lading or Airway Bills, customs export declarations, warehouse receipt and inventory movement reports, and detailed reconciliation between trade invoices and shipping evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Proposed credit of funds from or disbursement to a director's personal bank account instead of corporate trade counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate governance minutes authorising the specific payment, employment contracts and remuneration policies, independent supplier verification letters, third-party bank references, source-of-wealth statement for all personal-account touches, and audited audit trail tying every payment to the underlying eyewear trade transaction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The parent shareholder must remit via SWIFT MT103 from a qualifying corporate bank account to the International Company's USD or WST account at an authorised dealer in Samoa. Payment narrative must clearly state 'Share subscription – capital contribution' with the Central Bank of Samoa purpose code for inbound equity investment. The receiving bank will require a board resolution approving the capital injection, an updated register of members, a source-of-funds statement from the remitting shareholder, and a certificate of good standing from the Samoa International Companies Registry. Funds are credited only after the bank completes single-large-risk checks and confirms the transaction does not breach exchange control restrictions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound supplier settlements for acetate eyeglass frames are executed primarily through SWIFT MT103 from the Samoan corporate account to the beneficiary's correspondent bank. For OEM frame purchases, banks also accept irrevocable documentary sight letters of credit issued against 100% cash cover. Platform-based payments through non-bank EMI aggregators are not permitted for trade disbursements because the Central Bank of Samoa does not recognise unlicensed electronic money channels; all disbursements must clear via the local authorised dealer's Nostro/correspondent network with full supporting trade documentation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot foreign currency purchases and sales through a licensed authorised dealer
Plain-vanilla deliverable forward contracts with a tenour up to 12 months approved by the Central Bank of Samoa
Cross-currency swaps solely with the Central Bank's case-by-case approval; non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not offered in the domestic Samoan market

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company License Renewal (payment of annual government fee to maintain registration and corporate existence)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa, administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary date; SIFA customarily applies a 30-day grace period from the anniversary before late-payment penalties accrue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-payment penalty plus any prescribed recovery fee accrues after the grace period (minimum USD 50 per offence in practice); continued non-payment for approximately 12 consecutive months authorises the Registrar to publish a strike-off notice in the Samoa Official Gazette; the company is dissolved unless all arrears, penalties, and the restoration fee are paid; restoration is by application to the Registrar followed by payment of all outstanding amounts and registrar costs where applicable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered-Agent Compliance Attestation and Register Audit (on-site verification of the statutory registers, registered office, directors, shareholders, and beneficial-ownership records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No government filing; the attestation is completed and retained by the licensed registered agent in Samoa and must be produced to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) or SIFA upon lawful demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary, aligned with the SIFA renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain accurate registers or to complete the annual attestation is an offence under Samoa AML/CFT Regulations and the International Companies Act 1987; sanctions include civil penalties against the company and officers, reporting by the agent to the FIU, and possible agent resignation leading to administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing (issued upon application; confirms no outstanding annual fees and that the company is duly registered)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies / Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On demand throughout the year; issued within 3–5 business days after confirmation by the Registrar that the company is in good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not applicable; issuance is refused or withheld until all annual renewal fees and any applicable penalties are settled.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a standard Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 1987. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only where the company holds a banking, insurance, or other designated financial-services licence, where the High Court has ordered an audit, or where the company's own Memorandum and Articles require one; a wholesale distribution International Company with no regulated licence is statutorily exempt from audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) is the recognised accounting framework in Samoa; International Companies may keep accounts under IFRS or IFRS for SMEs, but are not required to file financial statements with the Registrar, which is consistent with the Tax_Exempt_Zone status of Samoa International Companies (no Samoan income tax or annual tax filing requirement).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent conducts an annual KYC and beneficial-ownership re-verification at each incorporation anniversary; any share transfer, allotment, or change of directors/controllers must be notified to the registered agent in writing within 21 days; Samoa does not maintain a public UBO register, so beneficial-ownership data remains confidential and is held by the registered agent, available for disclosure to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) or SIFA on lawful request only.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges (mortgages, charges and encumbrances over company assets)
Minute Book (resolutions of directors and members)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable (statutory exemption); voluntary certified audit, if commissioned, typically USD 4,000 – 8,000

stage_6.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for Samoa International Company (ICA 1987 s.231 exemption); 27% statutory resident corporate rate (Income Tax Act 2012)
stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full income tax exemption for the first 20 years from incorporation; no capital gains tax; exemption from dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax on distributions to non-residents
